# outputs/yearly/ — Per-Year SST Maps & Series

One folder per calendar year with regional SST timeseries plots, maps, and supporting CSVs.

## Contents

Folders `2016/` … `2026/` (study core 2006–2025; later years appear when processed). Typical files per year: `sst_map.png`, `regional_sst_timeseries.png`, `sst_statistics.csv`.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/process_all_years.py`

## Upstream / Downstream

`outputs/timeseries/combined_sst_*.nc` and regional CSVs → yearly snapshots → quick year reviews (e.g. extreme **2024**, busy **2025** with 13 Hobday starts).

## Notes

Year folders are convenience views; authoritative event lists remain in `outputs/mhw/catalogue/`.
